#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate SVG charts for the European economic performance story."""
import os

W, H = 960, 500
ML, MR, MT, MB = 90, 40, 70, 80

C = {
    'blue':   '#2E86AB',
    'red':    '#E63946',
    'green':  '#2A9D8F',
    'gold':   '#E9C46A',
    'gray':   '#8D99AE',
    'dark':   '#1D3557',
    'ink':    '#212529',
    'muted':  '#6C757D',
    'grid':   '#DEE2E6',
}

FONT = 'Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif'

def esc(s):
    return str(s).replace('&', '&').replace('<', '<').replace('>', '>')

def open_svg(title, subtitle=''):
    p = [f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{W}" height="{H}" viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}">',
         f'<rect width="{W}" height="{H}" fill="#ffffff"/>',
         f'<text x="{W/2}" y="36" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="23" font-weight="bold" fill="{C["dark"]}" text-anchor="middle">{esc(title)}</text>']
    if subtitle:
        p.append(f'<text x="{W/2}" y="58" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="13.5" fill="{C["muted"]}" text-anchor="middle">{esc(subtitle)}</text>')
    return p

def close_svg(p):
    p.append('</svg>')
    return '\n'.join(p)

def plot_box():
    return ML, MT, W - ML - MR, H - MT - MB

def grid_h(p, vmin, vmax, nticks=5, fmt='{:.0f}'):
    px, py, pw, ph = plot_box()
    for i in range(nticks + 1):
        v = vmin + (vmax - vmin) * i / nticks
        y = py + ph - (v - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) * ph
        p.append(f'<line x1="{px}" y1="{y:.1f}" x2="{px+pw}" y2="{y:.1f}" stroke="{C["grid"]}" stroke-width="1"/>')
        p.append(f'<text x="{px-12}" y="{y+4:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="12" fill="{C["muted"]}" text-anchor="end">{fmt.format(v)}</text>')
    p.append(f'<line x1="{px}" y1="{py+ph}" x2="{px+pw}" y2="{py+ph}" stroke="{C["ink"]}" stroke-width="1.5"/>')
    p.append(f'<line x1="{px}" y1="{py}" x2="{px}" y2="{py+ph}" stroke="{C["ink"]}" stroke-width="1.5"/>')

def y_of(v, vmin, vmax):
    px, py, pw, ph = plot_box()
    return py + ph - (v - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) * ph

def x_of(i, n):
    px, py, pw, ph = plot_box()
    step = pw / max(n - 1, 1)
    return px + i * step

def legend(p, items, x=None, y=None):
    if x is None:
        x = ML
    if y is None:
        y = MT - 26
    cx = x
    for color, label, shape in items:
        if shape == 'line':
            p.append(f'<line x1="{cx}" y1="{y}" x2="{cx+26}" y2="{y}" stroke="{color}" stroke-width="3.5"/>')
            p.append(f'<circle cx="{cx+13}" cy="{y}" r="4.5" fill="{color}"/>')
        else:
            p.append(f'<rect x="{cx}" y="{y-9}" width="16" height="16" rx="2" fill="{color}"/>')
        p.append(f'<text x="{cx+32}" y="{y+5}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="13" fill="{C["ink"]}">{esc(label)}</text>')
        cx += 32 + len(label) * 7.6 + 26
    return p

def save(name, body):
    os.makedirs('charts', exist_ok=True)
    with open(f'charts/{name}', 'w') as f:
        f.write(body)
    print('wrote', f'charts/{name}')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Chart 1
def chart_inflation_growth():
    p = open_svg('The Great Disinflation',
                 'EU-27 annual inflation vs. GDP growth, 2022-2024  (in %)')
    px, py, pw, ph = plot_box()
    vmin, vmax = 0, 10
    grid_h(p, vmin, vmax, nticks=5)
    ty = y_of(2, vmin, vmax)
    p.append(f'<line x1="{px}" y1="{ty:.1f}" x2="{px+pw}" y2="{ty:.1f}" stroke="{C["gold"]}" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="7,5"/>')
    p.append(f'<text x="{px+pw-4}" y="{ty-7:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="12.5" fill="#B08A2E" text-anchor="end">ECB target: 2%</text>')
    years = ['2022', '2023', '2024']
    inflation = [9.2, 6.4, 2.4]
    growth = [3.4, 0.4, 0.9]
    n = len(years)
    def line_pts(vals):
        return ' '.join(f'{x_of(i, n):.1f},{y_of(v, vmin, vmax):.1f}' for i, v in enumerate(vals))
    p.append(f'<polyline points="{line_pts(inflation)}" fill="none" stroke="{C["red"]}" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>')
    p.append(f'<polyline points="{line_pts(growth)}" fill="none" stroke="{C["blue"]}" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>')
    for i, v in enumerate(inflation):
        x, y = x_of(i, n), y_of(v, vmin, vmax)
        p.append(f'<circle cx="{x:.1f}" cy="{y:.1f}" r="6" fill="white" stroke="{C["red"]}" stroke-width="3"/>')
        p.append(f'<text x="{x:.1f}" y="{y-14:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="{C["red"]}" text-anchor="middle">{v:.1f}%</text>')
    for i, v in enumerate(growth):
        x, y = x_of(i, n), y_of(v, vmin, vmax)
        p.append(f'<circle cx="{x:.1f}" cy="{y:.1f}" r="6" fill="white" stroke="{C["blue"]}" stroke-width="3"/>')
        p.append(f'<text x="{x:.1f}" y="{y+22:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="{C["blue"]}" text-anchor="middle">{v:+.1f}%</text>')
    for i, yr in enumerate(years):
        p.append(f'<text x="{x_of(i, n):.1f}" y="{py+ph+28}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="14" fill="{C["ink"]}" text-anchor="middle">{yr}</text>')
    ay = y_of(9.2, vmin, vmax)
    p.append(f'<text x="{px+16}" y="{ay-16}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="12.5" fill="{C["muted"]}">Energy & supply shock</text>')
    p.append(f'<text x="{px+16}" y="{ay-2}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="12.5" fill="{C["muted"]}">after the Ukraine war</text>')
    p = legend(p, [(C['red'], 'Inflation', 'line'), (C['blue'], 'GDP growth', 'line')])
    save('chart_inflation_growth.svg', close_svg(p))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Chart 2
def chart_growth_2024():
    p = open_svg('Two-Speed Europe: GDP Growth in 2024',
                 'Real GDP growth by country, 2024 (in %) - EU average: +0.9%')
    px, py, pw, ph = plot_box()
    vmin, vmax = -1.2, 3.8
    grid_h(p, vmin, vmax, nticks=5)
    data = [('Spain', 3.2), ('Poland', 3.0), ('France', 0.9), ('Sweden', 0.8),
            ('Netherlands', 0.7), ('Italy', 0.5), ('Germany', -0.3)]
    n = len(data)
    row_h = ph / n
    bar_h = row_h * 0.5
    zx = px + (0 - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) * pw
    p.append(f'<line x1="{zx:.1f}" y1="{py}" x2="{zx:.1f}" y2="{py+ph}" stroke="{C["ink"]}" stroke-width="1.6"/>')
    p.append(f'<text x="{zx:.1f}" y="{py+ph+20}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="12" fill="{C["muted"]}" text-anchor="middle">0%</text>')
    euy = y_of(0.9, vmin, vmax)
    p.append(f'<line x1="{zx:.1f}" y1="{euy:.1f}" x2="{px+pw}" y2="{euy:.1f}" stroke="{C["gold"]}" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="7,5"/>')
    p.append(f'<text x="{px+pw-4}" y="{euy-7:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="12" fill="#B08A2E" text-anchor="end">EU average +0.9%</text>')
    for i, (country, v) in enumerate(data):
        yc = py + i * row_h + row_h / 2
        xv = px + (v - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) * pw
        color = C['red'] if v < 0 else C['blue']
        if v >= 0:
            p.append(f'<rect x="{zx:.1f}" y="{yc-bar_h/2:.1f}" width="{xv-zx:.1f}" height="{bar_h:.1f}" rx="3" fill="{color}"/>')
            p.append(f'<text x="{xv+8:.1f}" y="{yc+5:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="{color}">+{v:.1f}%</text>')
        else:
            p.append(f'<rect x="{xv:.1f}" y="{yc-bar_h/2:.1f}" width="{zx-xv:.1f}" height="{bar_h:.1f}" rx="3" fill="{color}"/>')
            p.append(f'<text x="{xv-8:.1f}" y="{yc+5:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="{color}" text-anchor="end">{v:.1f}%</text>')
        p.append(f'<text x="{px-12}" y="{yc+5:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="14" fill="{C["ink"]}" text-anchor="end">{country}</text>')
    p = legend(p, [(C['blue'], 'Expanding', 'rect'), (C['red'], 'Contracting', 'rect')])
    save('chart_growth_2024.svg', close_svg(p))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Chart 3
def chart_trade_balance():
    p = open_svg('The EUR 190 Billion Trade Turnaround',
                 'EU-27 trade balance, 2022-2024 (EUR billion)')
    px, py, pw, ph = plot_box()
    vmin, vmax = -230, 30
    grid_h(p, vmin, vmax, nticks=5)
    data = [('2022', -198.4), ('2023', -32.1), ('2024', -8.3)]
    n = len(data)
    slot = pw / n
    bar_w = slot * 0.42
    zx = px + (0 - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) * pw
    p.append(f'<line x1="{zx:.1f}" y1="{py}" x2="{zx:.1f}" y2="{py+ph}" stroke="{C["ink"]}" stroke-width="1.6"/>')
    for i, (year, v) in enumerate(data):
        cx = px + i * slot + slot / 2
        xv = px + (v - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) * pw
        yb = y_of(v, vmin, vmax)
        if v >= 0:
            p.append(f'<rect x="{cx-bar_w/2:.1f}" y="{yb:.1f}" width="{bar_w:.1f}" height="{py+ph-yb:.1f}" rx="4" fill="{C["green"]}"/>')
            p.append(f'<text x="{cx:.1f}" y="{yb-10:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="{C["green"]}" text-anchor="middle">+{v:.1f}</text>')
        else:
            p.append(f'<rect x="{cx-bar_w/2:.1f}" y="{yb:.1f}" width="{bar_w:.1f}" height="{py+ph-yb:.1f}" rx="4" fill="{C["red"]}"/>')
            p.append(f'<text x="{cx:.1f}" y="{yb-10:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="{C["red"]}" text-anchor="middle">{v:.1f}</text>')
        p.append(f'<text x="{cx:.1f}" y="{py+ph+28}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="14" fill="{C["ink"]}" text-anchor="middle">{year}</text>')
    p.append(f'<text x="{zx-14}" y="{py+ph-14}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="12.5" fill="{C["muted"]}" text-anchor="end">Deficit</text>')
    p.append(f'<text x="{zx+14}" y="{py+ph-14}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="12.5" fill="{C["muted"]}">Surplus</text>')
    p.append(f'<text x="{px+pw}" y="{py+18}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="12.5" fill="{C["muted"]}" text-anchor="end">Change: +EUR 190.1 bn</text>')
    save('chart_trade_balance.svg', close_svg(p))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Chart 4
def chart_debt():
    p = open_svg('Public Debt: Consolidation Continues',
                 'Government debt as % of GDP, 2022 vs. 2024')
    px, py, pw, ph = plot_box()
    vmin, vmax = 0, 155
    grid_h(p, vmin, vmax, nticks=5)
    data = [('Italy', 141.7, 134.8), ('France', 111.8, 112.0), ('Spain', 113.2, 104.3),
            ('Germany', 66.3, 62.9), ('Poland', 49.1, 51.3), ('Netherlands', 51.0, 44.2),
            ('Sweden', 33.0, 33.4)]
    n = len(data)
    row_h = ph / n
    bar_h = row_h * 0.30
    for i, (country, v22, v24) in enumerate(data):
        yc = py + i * row_h + row_h / 2
        for offset, v, color in [(-row_h*0.19, v22, C['gray']), (row_h*0.19, v24, C['green'])]:
            ybar = yc - bar_h / 2 + offset
            xw = px + v / (vmax - vmin) * pw
            p.append(f'<rect x="{px:.1f}" y="{ybar:.1f}" width="{xw-px:.1f}" height="{bar_h:.1f}" rx="3" fill="{color}"/>')
        x22 = px + v22 / (vmax - vmin) * pw
        x24 = px + v24 / (vmax - vmin) * pw
        p.append(f'<text x="{x22+7:.1f}" y="{yc-row_h*0.19+4:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="12" fill="{C["muted"]}">{v22:.1f}</text>')
        p.append(f'<text x="{x24+7:.1f}" y="{yc+row_h*0.19+4:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="{C["green"]}">{v24:.1f}</text>')
        p.append(f'<text x="{px-12}" y="{yc+5:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="14" fill="{C["ink"]}" text-anchor="end">{country}</text>')
    p = legend(p, [(C['gray'], '2022', 'rect'), (C['green'], '2024', 'rect')])
    save('chart_debt.svg', close_svg(p))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Chart 5
def chart_unemployment():
    p = open_svg('Labour Markets Held the Line',
                 'Unemployment rate, 2022 vs. 2024 (in %)')
    px, py, pw, ph = plot_box()
    vmin, vmax = 0, 15
    grid_h(p, vmin, vmax, nticks=5)
    data = [('Spain', 12.9, 11.3), ('Sweden', 7.5, 8.4), ('France', 7.3, 7.5),
            ('Italy', 8.1, 6.9), ('Netherlands', 3.5, 3.8), ('Germany', 3.1, 3.4),
            ('Poland', 2.9, 3.0)]
    n = len(data)
    row_h = ph / n
    bar_h = row_h * 0.30
    for i, (country, v22, v24) in enumerate(data):
        yc = py + i * row_h + row_h / 2
        for offset, v, color in [(-row_h*0.19, v22, C['gray']), (row_h*0.19, v24, C['blue'])]:
            ybar = yc - bar_h / 2 + offset
            xw = px + v / (vmax - vmin) * pw
            p.append(f'<rect x="{px:.1f}" y="{ybar:.1f}" width="{xw-px:.1f}" height="{bar_h:.1f}" rx="3" fill="{color}"/>')
        x22 = px + v22 / (vmax - vmin) * pw
        x24 = px + v24 / (vmax - vmin) * pw
        p.append(f'<text x="{x22+7:.1f}" y="{yc-row_h*0.19+4:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="12" fill="{C["muted"]}">{v22:.1f}</text>')
        p.append(f'<text x="{x24+7:.1f}" y="{yc+row_h*0.19+4:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="{C["blue"]}">{v24:.1f}</text>')
        p.append(f'<text x="{px-12}" y="{yc+5:.1f}" font-family="{FONT}" font-size="14" fill="{C["ink"]}" text-anchor="end">{country}</text>')
    p = legend(p, [(C['gray'], '2022', 'rect'), (C['blue'], '2024', 'rect')])
    save('chart_unemployment.svg', close_svg(p))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    chart_inflation_growth()
    chart_growth_2024()
    chart_trade_balance()
    chart_debt()
    chart_unemployment()
    print('All charts generated.')
